description: LATE BOX ARRIVALS 2 - HOW MANY ARE AHEAD. vf4 per-slot loop 0x143dff8d0..0x143dff961 counts team-mates positioned ahead of the candidate and rejects him if more than 2 are. A midfielder arriving late behind a front three plus a wide man is always above that. Raises the cap to 4. One private imm8.
